notes:
Tasks: accepting a task no longer asks for a reason — swipe right and it is accepted. On a task you assigned that nobody has accepted yet, swipe right to edit it. When you ask for more time, "Why do you need longer?" is now marked as required.

Deleting many tasks at once is now for a Super Admin, and for anyone the Super Admin gives the new "Bulk delete" permission (a CEO or MD too) — they can tick and delete any task they can see.

Training: a new My Trainings page shows the sessions you are booked on, with a Join button for the meeting and a short review afterwards. Organisers can add a meeting link, files and categories, and download a monthly report.

Admins: a new Attendance Records page lists punches by day and person, where they can be corrected, deleted or exported.

Audit log: each entry now reads as a sentence, with a Details view.
